# .octo

This repository uses [octo](https://github.com/cloudstashhq/octo) for developer workflows and repo-scoped extensions.

## For AI Assistants

If you are an AI assistant (Claude, Copilot, etc.) working in this repo:

Octo docs are at `$OCTO_DOCS/`.

1. Read the octo docs for context: `cat $OCTO_DOCS/README.md`
2. Understand extensions: run `octo orient`, then search zuno for `octo:guide:document:authoring-extensions`
3. Extension commands live in `.octo/ext/commands/<name>/`, each declared by an `ext.yml` manifest; run `octo help` here to list them
4. Commit messages MUST follow Conventional Commits with required scope: `type(scope): subject`
5. Run `octo doctor` to verify environment health
6. Run `octo commit` for AI-assisted commits (do not use git commit directly)

## Extensions

Repo-scoped `octo <name>` commands live under `.octo/ext/commands/<name>/`,
each declared by an `ext.yml` manifest (dispatch mode `exec` or `shell`) from
which dispatch, `octo help`, completion, and the command corpus all derive.
Run `octo help` inside this repo to list its extensions.

The corpus is the source of truth — this README only signposts it. To author
or convert an extension, read the authoring guide from zuno rather than
duplicating the schema here:

    octo orient                       # how to search octo's knowledge store
    # then search zuno for: octo:guide:document:authoring-extensions

## Structure

    .octo/
      config.yml                  # Repo configuration (do not hardcode — use defaults)
      README.md                   # This file (readonly — regenerate with octo setup)
      ext/
        commands/                 # Repo-scoped extension commands (_octo_ext_*)
        scripts/                  # Helper scripts referenced by commands
        instructions/             # Repo-specific instructions (e.g., commit.md)

## Documentation

    cat $OCTO_DOCS/README.md         # Documentation index
    octo orient                      # Writing extensions (search zuno: authoring-extensions)
    cat $OCTO_DOCS/config.md         # Configuration format and settings
    cat $OCTO_DOCS/commands.md       # Built-in command reference
    cat $OCTO_DOCS/doctor.md         # Health checks and troubleshooting

## Environment Variables

These are set by `octo init` and available in every terminal session:

| Variable | Resolves To | Purpose |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `$OCTO_ROOT` | `$(brew --prefix)/share/octo` | Root of octo's installed files |
| `$OCTO_SCRIPTS` | `$OCTO_ROOT/scripts` | Built-in command scripts |
| `$OCTO_DOCS` | `$OCTO_ROOT/docs` | Documentation files |
| `$OCTO_INSTRUCTIONS` | `$OCTO_ROOT/_internal/instructions` | Commit generation instructions |

Use these in commands and documentation instead of hardcoding paths.

## Quick Reference

    octo doctor          # Check terminal and repo health
    octo commit          # AI-assisted commit workflow
    octo commit --help   # Commit command details
    octo reload          # Reload extension commands
    octo --help          # All commands
